content.GEOID: String: 5-digit county ID (state FIPS + county FIPS)
content.STATEFP: String: 2-digit FIPS code for the corresponding state
content.NAME: String: County name
content.LSAD: String: 2-digit Legal/Statistical Area Description code. See https://www.census.gov/library/reference/code-lists/legal-status-codes.html for further description of LSAD codes
